title: Fluvv Glossary
description: A domain's business vocabulary. One file per domain under governance/glossaries/. Contract columns reference a term by their ODCS `businessName`. See docs/fluvv/SPEC.md Section 5.

domain.description: The domain this glossary belongs to; must have a domain file.

name.description: PascalCase term name, used as columns' `businessName` (e.g. ModelYear).

definition.description: What the term means, independent of any one table. Column-specific notes (renames, aggregation scope) belong in the column's own `description`.

synonyms.description: Extra synonyms. Physical column names using the term are added automatically.

relatedTerms.description: Other terms in this glossary this one relates to.
